title: Moved classes follow the type the game's own signatures name in their place
text: 26.3 split the old device classes (GpuTexture, GpuTextureView, GpuSampler, GpuBuffer, GpuDevice, GpuSurface, CommandEncoder, RenderPass) into an API interface in renderpearl.api, which every caller's signature names, and a backend class holding the old bodies. The class matcher refused a class-to-interface pair and matched by body likeness, so the route sent these classes to the backend classes or dropped them, and every mod call on them broke. GameDiff now links a class to the type linked members' parameters, results and field types switched to in its place (three votes, 80% agreement, a type no other old class is voted to, class to interface allowed); it takes over a likeness link only for the class that kept the old name. The 26.2 -> 26.3 RenderSystem stand-in, which only coped with the wrong route, is removed.
finish: On 26.2 -> 26.3 the device classes map to the API interfaces, every update links at least as many mods, and the freed mods load in a real game
wrongIf: a class links to a parent or wrapper its signatures widened to (Slime to AbstractCubeMob, StructureTemplatePool to Holder), or a freed mod fails in game on a device class
result: All eight 26.3 device classes now map to renderpearl.api; GpuSampler, GpuBuffer and GpuDevice are no longer dropped. Broken uses on 26.2 -> 26.3 fall 2,058 -> 1,544 (NeoForge) and 1,986 -> 1,539 (Fabric). Cloud scoreboard 45133652897 against main 93080c5: every update 6,680 -> 6,685, big updates 2,517 -> 2,522, newest game 23 -> 23, no update lower; NeoForge and Fabric 26.2 -> 26.3 66 -> 68 and 62 -> 64 (Almanac, YACL), Fabric 1.15.2 -> 1.16 74 -> 75 (Totally Lit). In game (cloud-load 45134377647, 45134397414): Almanac, YACL, BetterF3 and Konkrete load in a 26.3 client on both loaders and on the server (BetterF3 is client-only on Fabric). Totally Lit fails on Fabric API's FabricBlockSettings.copyOf missing on 1.16 (cloud-load 45139910426), as main's receipt already shows: a loader-API break the link check misses, not this change. Elsewhere 25 update maps changed, nearly all by classes the route already rewrote to the same target now linked with their members (Block$Properties, LootContextParam, GameRules$Key); new links are RegistryAccess$RegistryHolder to Frozen, Fabric API ConditionJsonProvider to ResourceCondition and 1.21.5 CompiledShaderProgram to RenderPass, none moving a mod; a first try also moved Slime, WindCharge, UniformInt and StructureTemplatePool to parents their signatures widened to, now refused. The freed count is small because most of the 45 mods per loader that touch these classes also hold other breaks: RenderPass.setPipeline, whose signature changed, renderer redesigns and mixins.
